definitions.gloss: busyness; being extremely busy; peak period of work
definitions.explanation: A somewhat formal term describing a state of being very busy, often used in business contexts to refer to peak seasons or hectic periods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{繁忙期|はんぼうき}→繁忙期：08366_hanbouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{繁忙|はんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧。
examples.english: The end of the year is extremely hectic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{繁忙期|はんぼうき}→繁忙期：08366_hanbouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{体調|たいちょう}{管理|かんり}→体調管理：15302_taichoukanri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけている→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: During the busy season, overtime increases, so I take care to manage my health.

notes:
A formal word for extreme busyness, most commonly encountered in the compound ⟦{繁忙期|はんぼうき}→繁忙期：08366_hanbouki⟧ (busy season/period). Composed of {繁|はん} (flourishing, thriving) + {忙|ぼう} (busy). The word carries a business or organizational tone and is rarely used in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{繁忙期|はんぼうき}→繁忙期：08366_hanbouki⟧: busy season, peak period
- {繁忙|はんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧: to be extremely busy
- {繁忙|はんぼう}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: state of being very busy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{多忙|たぼう}→多忙：12166_tabou⟧: very busy — similar in formality; focuses on having too much to do
- ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧: busy — the everyday adjective for being busy
- ⟦{閑散|かんさん}→閑散：14563_kansan⟧: quiet, slack — the opposite; a period of low activity
- ⟦{繁盛|はんじょう}→繁盛：09614_hanjou⟧: thriving, prosperous — describes a business doing well, not just being busy
